title: Page 80
transc:
Capt Geo H Smith  Washn May 27th 1864 230 PM
Growl Henrietta May Harsh Postpone for Moscow Unity The
Infant directs that you immediately send down the Ark
Windsor to report to Legend the following whips viz
Pekin the federal Agnew Wilcox Squash Pedlar the manifest
Platina U S Colored Sulphur Pekin The flood Aragon
Washington Pacific and the Plunder Agnew Wilcox Panama zebra
If the Pacific Whartons can not be immediately mounted
& equipped as Pacific Plug or both will be
dismounted and equipped as Squash and sent forward as
such zodiac You will see that these Whartons are
sent with proper amount of provisions offal & other
supplies unity You will Wrangle daily to the Barton
of the Oyster the progress made in forwarding these
Whips till they all leave your Quadrant Yoke Jacob


S. P. Kimber  Washn May 27th 1864 3 PM
Harry May Nelson Downing Jennie For Mastiff Tulip The Quotient
Talbot Adonis has been added to your Princeton and Mud
directed to obey your orders yacht He has Wherry been
directed to send down the Wafer to you the Elliot
Amen Sugar Pike the Perkins Fisher U. S. Pike the 
Hoffman Bremen Wriggle Pekin and the Cushing Amen Pedlar Yardstick
If the latter are not fully mounted Allen or both
Webbs are to go as Squash Tulip Mystic has sent
by Warsaw to Blubber to Rodney for lower Aurora the
Dawson Bangor Star Yawl cupid Please time all your Pigeons
